title: Software Engineer, Production Engineering  (London, United Kingdom)

fields.label: Why do you want to join Figma?*
fields.name: question_15245564004
fields.ourAnswer: I am drawn to Figma because of its mission to democratize design and empower creative teams worldwide. With 8 years of software engineering experience, I'm excited to lead a team that bridges the gap between design and engineering—an area where I've seen firsthand how better collaboration drives product excellence. Figma's collaborative platform, innovative approach to design tooling, and commitment to building world-class products align with my passion for creating intuitive, impactful software. I'm eager to contribute to a team that's shaping the future of design technology.

fields.label: Additional Information
fields.name: question_15245566004
fields.ourAnswer: UK work authorization: I am a US citizen with valid passport and will require visa sponsorship (Skilled Worker visa) to work in the United Kingdom. I have 8 years of IT engineering experience and am relocating to London. Portfolio: https://koundinyapidaparhty.vercel.app
